candidates.agronomic_rationale: Targets high-yield outliers by relaxing GDD base to tmin 10th percentile (0.94°C) to include warmer northern zones, raising upper limit to tmax 95th percentile (31.25°C) to capture heat-stressed but potentially high-radiation scenarios, and tightening precipitation threshold (1.0mm) to identify early drought onset risks that suppress yield despite high thermal sums.
